Maintainer.Profile: MrQuentinet (github.com/mrquentin) - Unraid templates from mrquentin/bambu-controller. Bambu Controller is a self-hosted web app to monitor and control Bambu Lab 3D printers in LAN Only Mode: no cloud, no account. Images are published to GHCR (amd64 + arm64) with signed build provenance and run unprivileged with a read-only root filesystem.
